sources.title: GitHub - Contrastive-LM/CLM
sources.snippet: 🔥 Contrastive Language Models (CLMs) are a new class of System One model trained with a contrastive learning objective that connects states and actions. This repo serves CLM-8B behind a TypeSafe-compatible API.
